leadership: Lead yourself first: Word, prayer, obedience. Authority flows from humility.
Set the tone at home—repent fast, encourage often, serve first.
marriage: Fight for each other, not against each other. Pray briefly daily and serve first.
Honor your wife in public, understand her in private, and lead with sacrificial love.
parenting: Correction + connection: win the heart, then the habit.
Consistency beats intensity. Model what you want multiplied.
identity: Your past is not your rank. In Christ you’re chosen and commissioned.
Walk like a man under good orders—beloved and sent.

leadership.txt: Do justice, and love kindness, and walk humbly with your God.
Set the believers an example in speech, in conduct, in love, in faith, in purity.

marriage.txt: Husbands, love your wives, as Christ loved the church and gave himself up for her.

parenting.txt: Train up a child in the way he should go; even when he is old he will not depart from it.

identity.txt: You are a chosen race, a royal priesthood...

prayers: King Jesus, teach me to lead by serving. Give me courage, humility, and ears that hear Your orders. Amen.
